items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1969-12-30
items.q: I had to get rid of him, so I wanted to still keep the band after going through all of this with Furrier.

ctx.x: Yeah, you mentioned that that had to do with the breaking up of the band.

Well, that happened in the later, later years. I broke up that one time right after Al Travis said to give us that bad booking. And I came back to New Orleans. I thought I wanted to quit. So, I'm being before you, I thought that some Negro agent came here and could make a tremendous, a lot of money for his boy. And I tried to explain what type of deal this was, but he went ahead and he let me have $4,000. And this proved to be a bad booker. I had to get rid of him, so I wanted to still keep the band after going…
What about this Bernard Goldberg? Had you get in touch with him?
